examples.ko: 물이 끓는점에 도달하면 온도는 더 오르지 않아요.
examples.en: When water reaches its boiling point, its temperature doesn't rise any more.

examples.ko: 표준 기압에서 물의 끓는점은 백 도예요.
examples.en: At standard pressure, the boiling point of water is 100 degrees.

examples.ko: 높은 산에서는 끓는점이 낮아져서 밥이 설익어요.
examples.en: On a high mountain, the boiling point drops and rice comes out undercooked.
Salt water has a slightly higher boiling point than plain water.

examples.ko: 과학 시간에 여러 액체의 끓는점을 비교했어요.
examples.en: In science class, we compared the boiling points of several liquids.
A liquid with a low boiling point boils easily.

explain: 과학 수업에서 자주 나오는 말이고, 일상에서는 '물이 끓는 온도'처럼 풀어서 말하는 경우가 많아요. 반대 개념은 '어는점'이에요. '끓는점'은 '끓다'에 '-는'이 붙은 형태라 발음이 [끌른쩜]이 되는 점을 주의하세요.
explain_en: This word appears often in science class, while in everyday talk people usually say something like '물이 끓는 온도'. Its opposite concept is '어는점' (freezing point). Note the pronunciation [끌른쩜], which comes from '끓다' plus '-는'.

examples.en: In winter, temperature and heating costs are almost inversely related.
Exercise and body weight are not always inversely proportional.

examples.ko: 속도와 걸리는 시간은 서로 반비례하는 관계예요.
examples.en: Speed and travel time are inversely proportional to each other.

examples.ko: 케이크 크기가 같으면 사람 수와 한 사람 몫은 반비례해요.
examples.en: If the cake stays the same size, the number of people and each person's share are inversely proportional.

examples.ko: 가격과 수요가 꼭 반비례한다고 말할 수는 없어요.
examples.en: You can't say that price and demand are always inversely related.

examples.ko: 노력과 성적이 반비례하면 공부 방법을 바꿔야 해요.
examples.en: If your effort and grades move in opposite directions, you need to change how you study.

explain: '비례하다'(같이 늘고 줄다)의 반대로, 한쪽이 커질 때 다른 쪽이 작아지는 관계예요. 수학에서는 '정비례'와 짝으로 쓰고, 일상에서도 '둘은 반비례 관계예요'라고 말해요. 보통 'A와 B는 반비례하다'처럼 두 가지를 같이 말해요.
explain_en: It is the opposite of '비례하다' (rise and fall together): when one grows, the other shrinks. In math it pairs with '정비례', and in daily talk people say '둘은 반비례 관계예요'. You usually mention both things, as in 'A와 B는 반비례하다'.

examples.en: I draw a circle with a radius of 5 centimeters.

examples.ko: 원의 반지름 구하는 문제가 시험에 나왔어요.
examples.en: A problem about finding the radius of a circle came up on the test.
Half of the diameter is the radius.

examples.ko: 반지름을 두 배로 늘리면 넓이는 네 배가 돼요.
examples.en: If you double the radius, the area becomes four times as large.
You open the compass to the length of the radius and draw a circle.
What is the radius of this plate?

explain: '지름'과 짝으로 같이 외워 두면 좋아요. 수학에서는 '반지름' 대신 '반경'이라고도 해요.
explain_en: It is useful to learn it as a pair with '지름' (diameter). In math you may also see '반경' used for it.

examples.en: After graduating I want to work at an industrial company.
Industry and the school do research together.
I went on a field internship at an industrial site.
There are many industrial companies in this area.
We need education that matches what industry wants.
Industry changes faster than schools.

explain: 산업체는 학교나 연구소와 구분해서, 물건을 만들고 파는 회사들을 한꺼번에 말할 때 써요. 뉴스나 학교 글에서 자주 나오고, 일상에서는 그냥 '회사'나 '공장'이라고 해요.
explain_en: 산업체 groups together the companies that make and sell things, as opposed to schools or research institutes. It appears often in news and school writing, while in daily talk people just say 회사 or 공장.

examples.ko: 이 수열을 보면 앞의 두 수를 더해서 다음 수가 나와요.
examples.en: Looking at this sequence, you add the two previous numbers to get the next one.

examples.ko: 수열의 다음 숫자가 뭔지 맞혀 보세요.
examples.en: Try to guess what the next number in the sequence is.

examples.ko: 수학 시간에 수열 문제를 풀다가 막혔어요.
examples.en: I got stuck while solving a sequence problem in math class.
A sequence like 1, 3, 5, 7 has a simple rule.

examples.ko: 이 수열에서 열 번째 수를 구하는 방법이 있어요?
examples.en: Is there a way to find the tenth number in this sequence?

examples.ko: 동생이 수열 규칙을 금방 찾아내서 놀랐어요.
examples.en: I was surprised that my younger sibling found the rule of the sequence so quickly.

explain: 수학 수업이나 시험에서 주로 쓰는 말이고, 보통 '규칙'과 함께 나와요. '등차수열', '등비수열'처럼 앞에 말을 붙여서도 써요.
explain_en: This word is mainly used in math classes and exams, and it usually appears together with '규칙' (rule). It also appears with a prefix, as in '등차수열' (arithmetic sequence) and '등비수열' (geometric sequence).

examples.ko: 용접 작업을 할 때는 보호 마스크를 꼭 써요.
examples.en: When you do welding work, you must wear a protective mask.

examples.ko: 형은 자동차 공장에서 용접을 맡고 있어요.
examples.en: My older brother is in charge of welding at a car factory.

examples.ko: 용접이 잘못되면 철판이 쉽게 떨어질 수 있어요.
examples.en: If the welding is done badly, the steel plates can easily come apart.

examples.ko: 이 철제 의자는 용접으로 붙여서 아주 튼튼해요.
examples.en: This metal chair is joined by welding, so it's very sturdy.

examples.ko: 요즘은 로봇이 용접을 대신해서 사고가 줄었어요.
examples.en: These days robots do the welding instead, so accidents have decreased.
I signed up for a class to learn welding skills.

explain: 철판이나 파이프 같은 금속을 열로 녹여 붙이는 일이에요. 작은 전자 부품을 붙이는 '납땜'과 구분하고, 이 일을 하는 사람은 '용접공'이라고 해요.
explain_en: It is the work of joining metal such as steel plates or pipes by melting them with heat. It differs from '납땜' (soldering small electronic parts), and the person who does it is called a '용접공' (welder).

en: to be adjusted; to be changed

examples.ko: 회의 시간이 한 시간 뒤로 조정돼요.
examples.en: The meeting time is adjusted to an hour later.
The price was adjusted last month.
I will tell you right away once the schedule is adjusted.
Please check the adjusted timetable.
The salary was adjusted from this year.
There is a part that has not been adjusted yet.

explain: 일정, 가격, 시간처럼 이미 정해진 것을 상황에 맞게 약간 바꾼다는 말이에요. 완전히 없애는 것이 아니라 맞추는 느낌이라 '취소되다'와 달라요. 안내문에서 자주 봐요.
explain_en: It is used for things already set, such as schedules, prices and times, being changed slightly to fit the situation. It feels like fitting rather than removing, so it differs from '취소되다'. You often see it in notices.

examples.en: Try finding the maximum value of this function.
The maximum value on the graph is twelve.
I calculated the difference between the maximum and minimum values.

examples.ko: 엑셀에서 최댓값을 찾는 방법을 알려 주세요.
examples.en: Please tell me how to find the maximum value in Excel.
The maximum temperature was reached yesterday afternoon.

examples.ko: 시험 점수 중 최댓값이 구십오 점이에요.
examples.en: The highest of the test scores is ninety-five.

explain: 반대말은 '최솟값'이에요. 수학, 엑셀, 통계에서 주로 쓰고, 일상 대화에서는 '제일 높은 점수'처럼 풀어서 말해요.
explain_en: The opposite is '최솟값'. It is used mainly in math, Excel and statistics, while in everyday talk people say things like '제일 높은 점수' (the highest score).

en: to be scheduled; to be planned

examples.en: The new drama was scheduled for Friday night.

examples.ko: 내년 예산이 교육에 많이 편성돼 있어요.
examples.en: A large share of next year's budget is allocated to education.
The team was newly formed, so it felt awkward at first.
Once the timetable is arranged, I'll tell the students.

examples.ko: 이 프로그램은 아침 시간대로 편성될 거예요.
examples.en: This program will be slotted into the morning.
The classes were organized by level, so the lessons became easier.

explain: 방송 시간표, 예산, 팀, 반처럼 여러 요소를 짜서 정리할 때 써요. 뉴스에서는 '예산이 편성되다'가 가장 자주 나와요. 일정이 그냥 정해지는 '정해지다'보다 틀을 짠다는 느낌이에요.
explain_en: Use it when several elements are arranged into a plan, such as a broadcast schedule, a budget, a team or a class. In the news, '예산이 편성되다' (a budget is drawn up) is the most common. Compared with '정해지다' (to be decided), it feels like a framework is being put together.

en: to play a role; to play a part

examples.en: That song played a part in the drama's popularity.
The good weather also plays a role in the festival's success.

examples.ko: 친구의 응원이 합격에 한몫한 것 같아요.
examples.en: I think my friend's encouragement helped me pass.

examples.ko: 이 앱은 편리해서 인기를 얻는 데 한몫하고 있어요.
examples.en: This app is convenient, which is helping it become popular.

examples.ko: 가격이 싼 것도 한몫하겠지만 품질이 더 중요해요.
examples.en: The low price will play a part too, but quality is more important.

examples.ko: 당신도 이번 일에 한몫했으니 같이 축하해요.
examples.en: You played a part in this too, so let's celebrate together.

explain: 'N이/가 ~에 한몫하다'처럼 어떤 일에 도움이 되거나 영향을 준 몫이 크다고 말할 때 써요. 좋은 결과에 많이 쓰지만 나쁜 결과에도 쓸 수 있어요. '한몫 잡다'처럼 큰 이익을 얻는 뜻의 표현과는 쓰임이 달라요.
explain_en: It is used as 'N이/가 ~에 한몫하다' to say something contributed a good share to a result. It is often used for good outcomes but can also be used for bad ones. It is different from '한몫 잡다', which means making a big profit.
